scientificVerdict: Some mass-proportional white-noise CSL parameter regions are experimentally restricted; none of these observations distinguish standard Everett branches from equilibrium Bohm's single actual configuration. No new universal ontology score.
evidenceLimits: Gamma posterior reproduction assumes publisher's 2 pseudo-counts; detector-model systematic background not independently propagated
LISA Eq10 is arithmetic reproduction from published fitted PSD, not independent mission noise analysis
Germanium Bayesian 95%, XENON frequentist 90%, LISA conservative noise cannot be pooled without explicit likelihood models
No digitization/invention of molecular or rotational numerical exclusion curves
Colored and dissipative CSL signal spectra not subject to blanket white-noise extrapolation
